page.overview:
What is Cubchoo?

Cubchoo resembles a baby polar bear. The top half of its plump body is covered in light-blue fur, while its lower half is white. It has black oval-shaped eyes, round ears, small, stubby paws and feet, and a round white tail. Cubchoo's muzzle is a deeper shade of blue, and it has a large, round black nose with a thick droplet of partially frozen mucus dripping down like an icicle. Always its nose is runny even when its healthy.

A Cubchoo's nose is always running; when they sniff the snot back up into their noses, the mucus provides them with the energy they need to use their -type attacks in battle. They sometimes smear their snots onto people it dislikes. When this Pokémon is sick, the mucus becomes watery, causing the power of their moves to decrease. Thus, Trainers can easily discern the health of their Cubchoo based on the viscosity of their substance; thick and sticky snot that holds together well indicates healthy Cubchoo, while thin and runny snot indicates ill ones.

A Cubchoo's snot can cause frostbite if it's sneezed onto somebody.

Cubchoo evolves into Beartic starting at level 37.
